newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran oil minister confirms Balal oilfield deal.
newsitem.headline: Iran oil minister confirms Balal oilfield deal.

text.p: Iran's oil minister on Saturday confirmed that Iran had awarded a contract to British and Canadian firms to develop the offshore Balal oilfield.
"The contract has been signed. The contractual issues have been finalised and the necessary guarantees have been obtained," Gholamreza Aghazadeh said.
"We have signed with two companies from Britain and Canada," he said in an interview.

Aghazadeh declined to name the two companies but sources at the National Iranian Oil Company said Britain's Pell Frischmann and Canada's Bow Valley would carry out work to produce 40,000 barrels per day (bpd) at the undeveloped offshore Balal field.
Aghazadeh added that Iran was in advanced negotiations with two consortiums headed by France's Total and Royal/Dutch Shell on developing phases two and three of Iran's huge South Pars gas field.
"We are advancing negotiations with these two consortiums very well and according to the schedule we had...The main issues have been finalised," he said.
The two-phase development would produce two billion cubic feet a day of gas after a construction period of five years.
